segments.t: Accept A Threat Within from Deputy Willem

tips.text: Deputy Willem stands on the path in front of the Abbey. Kill wolves and kobolds as you go; everything here is quick.

segments.t: Turn in A Threat Within to Marshal McBride; Accept Kobold Camp Cleanup from Marshal McBride
Accept Eagan Peltskinner from Deputy Willem
Turn in Eagan Peltskinner to Eagan Peltskinner; Accept Wolves Across the Border from Eagan Peltskinner

tips.text: Riley Peltskinner next to Eagan is the new junior Skinning trainer; Nancy Songflower (east of the Abbey) teaches Herbalism and Kelsey Fargo at Echo Ridge teaches Mining. Learning one now is free XP time later.

segments.t: Complete Kobold Camp Cleanup: 10 Kobold Vermin

tips.text: Kobold Vermin are in the field north of the Abbey. Kobolds here can drop a Nibbled-On Book; it starts a new Forever chain, so loot everything.

segments.t: Loot Nibbled-On Book and accept Nibbled-On Book

tips.text: New in Forever: the Nibbled-On Book drops from Northshire kobolds.

segments.t: Complete Wolves Across the Border: 8 Tough Wolf Meat

tips.text: Timber Wolves and Young Wolves roam the meadows around the Abbey. Meat drops are not guaranteed.

segments.t: Turn in Kobold Camp Cleanup to Marshal McBride; Accept Investigate Echo Ridge from Marshal McBride
Accept Simple Letter from Marshal McBride

tips.text: McBride hands out your class letter once the kobold camp is cleared. Read it and take it to your trainer.

segments.t: Accept Consecrated Letter from Marshal McBride
Accept Encrypted Letter from Marshal McBride
Accept Hallowed Letter from Marshal McBride
Accept Glyphic Letter from Marshal McBride
Accept Tainted Letter from Marshal McBride
Accept A Scribbled Letter from Marshal McBride

tips.text: New in Forever: Humans can be Hunters. Tordrin Sternblade waits by the stable behind the Abbey.

segments.t: Turn in Simple Letter to Llane Beshere
Turn in Consecrated Letter to Brother Sammuel
Turn in Tainted Letter to Drusilla La Salle
Accept The Stolen Tome from Drusilla La Salle

tips.text: Warlocks: the Powers of the Void tome sits by the Defias tents east of the Abbey. Do it with the bandana quest.

segments.t: Turn in Wolves Across the Border to Eagan Peltskinner
Turn in Glyphic Letter to Khelden Bremen
Turn in Hallowed Letter to Priestess Anetta
Turn in Encrypted Letter to Jorik Kerridan
Turn in A Scribbled Letter to Tordrin Sternblade
Turn in Nibbled-On Book to Brother Paxton; Accept Book Inventory from Brother Paxton
Turn in Book Inventory to Daniel; Accept Rascally Rodents from Brother Paxton
Accept Brotherhood of Thieves from Deputy Willem
Train your level 2 spells while you are in the Abbey

actions.label: Train your level 2 spells while you are in the Abbey

segments.t: Complete Investigate Echo Ridge: 10 Kobold Worker; Complete Rascally Rodents: 8 Stolen Book

tips.text: Kobold Workers fill the field north of the Abbey. Stolen Books drop from any kobold here, so keep killing until both are done.

segments.t: Complete Brotherhood of Thieves: 12 Red Burlap Bandana

tips.text: Defias Thugs camp in the vineyard east of the Abbey. Bandanas don't drop every kill.

segments.t: Complete The Stolen Tome: Powers of the Void

tips.text: The book pile is by the tents at the north end of the Thug camp.

segments.t: Turn in Investigate Echo Ridge to Marshal McBride; Accept Skirmish at Echo Ridge from Marshal McBride
Turn in Brotherhood of Thieves to Deputy Willem; Accept Bounty on Garrick Padfoot from Deputy Willem; Accept Milly Osworth from Deputy Willem
Turn in The Stolen Tome to Drusilla La Salle
Turn in Rascally Rodents to Brother Paxton; Accept Mining Consultant from Brother Paxton
Turn in Milly Osworth to Milly Osworth; Accept Milly's Harvest from Milly Osworth
Complete Milly's Harvest: 8 Milly's Harvest

tips.text: The crates sit between the vines in the Thug vineyard.

segments.t: Complete Bounty on Garrick Padfoot: Garrick's Head

tips.text: Garrick Padfoot stands by the cottage at the east end of the vineyard with two Thugs. Pull the guards first.

segments.t: Turn in Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth; Accept Grape Manifest from Milly Osworth
Turn in Grape Manifest to Brother Neals
Turn in Bounty on Garrick Padfoot to Deputy Willem
Train level 4 spells
Turn in Mining Consultant to Kelsey Fargo; Accept The Big Picture from Kelsey Fargo

tips.text: Kelsey Fargo waits at the Echo Ridge Mine entrance. She is also the junior Mining trainer.

segments.t: Complete Skirmish at Echo Ridge: 12 Kobold Laborer; Complete The Big Picture: Sack of "Picture" Books

tips.text: Kobold Laborers fill Echo Ridge Mine. Shinyfinder Narf is deep inside; loot his sack of books.

segments.t: Turn in Skirmish at Echo Ridge to Marshal McBride; Accept Report to Goldshire from Marshal McBride
Turn in The Big Picture to Marshal McBride; Accept Follow That Kobold! from Marshal McBride
Accept The Adventurer from Marshal McBride

tips.text: New in Forever: this sends you to Sam, the Camping 101 teacher near Goldshire. Free XP on the way.

segments.t: Turn in Follow That Kobold! to Tordrin Sternblade; Accept Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds from Tordrin Sternblade
Accept In Favor of the Light from Priestess Anetta

tips.text: Priests: you need level 5 for this. It sends you to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.

segments.t: Accept Rest and Relaxation from Falkhaan Isenstrider

tips.text: Falkhaan stands on the road south out of the valley.

segments.t: Complete Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds: Kobold Tracks

tips.text: Click the kobold tracks along the road south toward Goldshire.
